about_the_game:
The committee has spread the words - regardless of your background, the Fighting Pageant welcomes everyone from the city of Navalia. As long as you can appreciate each others' fighting prowess, you are invited to participate in this event that roots in the Empire's martial spirits.

You, the player, will participate in the Fighting Pageant as one of the residents of Navalia in this card battler. Master the unique turn system based on time frames - calculate your risks, and exploit your opponent's hasty decisions. Explore a range of playable fighters with distinctive play styles, each of whom has their own unique move set and mechanics.

LITE version features

  • New player guidance with Assistant

  • Play with/against 3 fighters

  • Play against Assistant

  • Play against other LITE version players

  • In sync with all quality of life improvements in FULL version

FULL version features (on top of LITE version)

  • Play with/against a total of 12 fighters

  • A new game mode

  • Play against other FULL version players

  • Visual customization options

  • Steam Deck support
detailed_description:
(Please Read) About Playtest

What's Included

Playtest opens in early development with 3 playable characters in total. There will be more added later on and an announcement will be made when a new character is ready for some testing. The "new game mode" mentioned in the game's description section is not included.

Invite Friends

Before using the Private Invite functionality, you would need to have some friends on Steam who are also in this Playtest. Once your access is granted, you should see the option to invite up to 2 friends while viewing the game from your library.

Feedback

You're welcomed to provide feedback or bug report through any publicly available method of contact. However, social media is not the best place since they're not being monitored. The preferred method would be the discussion board.

Thank you for your support and have fun!
